# sh-fpv-tit-for-tat-card

**Purpose:** The light card: the viewer unlocks a section by adding his own details.

**Switches:** Art, Reason, CTA, Blurred sample.

**Rules:** only for a Free viewer missing the same details; never replaces a lock that has a reason; light card = self-unlock, gold = pay.
